name: Myrmillones
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry (Sword & Shield, Heavy Armor) · shields · 245 leadership
pitch: A commitment-based shield unit built around one big shock hit — it goes all-in on the charge and has to hold its ground until the retreat window is safe. Anything that dodges or spreads against it shuts it down cold, which is why it eats CC the instant it commits.

doctrines.name: Block Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +300 block, -90 flat DMG taken (applied after all other reductions).

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Only recommendation given — no alternative line specified.

battleRole.positioning: Commit to the charge fully, then hold formation until retreat is certain — breaking the stance early is the main way this unit dies. {1}

cards.name: Anything that can dodge
cards.why: loses to units that can dodge the charge

cards.name: Stalwarts
cards.why: counters them, conditionally — "only if they don't press CC-i at right timing"

cards.name: Sunward Phalanx
cards.why: listed among the few things this unit counters

controls.notes: Press 1 (Shield Sortie/charge) for a huge shock attack, then hold BLOCK formation and repeat the loop. {1} Doctrine flex beyond the mandatories: lifesteal, block, damage-taken, or unique doctrines — pick per matchup. {1}
